method: Sequential real HTTP requests to local workerd; sum SqlStorageCursor.rowsWritten after handlers complete. No production requests or latency measurements.
scope: Existing workspace, team and authenticated member; one issue without labels, attachments or project; one status change; three comments. Initialization and fixture setup excluded.
